settings.heading: CBG And CBD For Focus
settings.text:
We talk a lot about CBD here at HempLucid, and for good reason. In addition to helping us FIGHT STRESS and find DEEPER SLEEP (without next-day grogginess), CBD can help induce a state of relaxed calm that helps us feel sharp, clear, and “in the zone.” As the major non-intoxicating compound in cannabis and hemp, CBD is an all-natural all-star when it comes to helping us access better MENTAL CLARITY AND FOCUS.  


Then there’s CBG, another cannabinoid that’s attracting a lot of attention. Like CBD, CBG isn’t intoxicating, and it supports our health with anxiety-reducing, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective qualities. As THIS EARLY STUDY suggests, it’s an all-natural compound we’ll be hearing much, much more about in the years to come.

settings.heading: Mushrooms For Focus
settings.text:
As powerful as CBD and CBG are, they’re not the only compounds we lean on here at HempLucid. Since the earliest days of Chinese medicine, humans have known that adaptogens and functional mushrooms such as chaga have the potential to help us manage stress and achieve deeper focus without intoxication. And here at HempLucid, one of the mushrooms we lean most on is Lion’s Mane.  


In addition to promising data suggesting that Lion’s Mane can enhance the activities of neurotransmitters, Lion's Mane compounds have been shown to potentially INCREASE THE LEVELS OF NERVE GROWTH FACTOR (NGF) in the brain. NGF is a protein that plays an important role in the health of nerve cells, which is vital for cognitive function, memory, and concentration.

settings.heading: Plant-Powered Proprietary Focus Blend
settings.text:
Here at HempLucid, we think life is BETTER WITHOUT CHEMICALS AND SYNTHETIC DRUGS in our systems. That’s a major reason our MUSHROOM FOCUS GUMMIES rely on Lion’s Mane, CBD and CBG, and brain-boosting botanicals such as green coffee beans, L-Tyrosine, and L-Theanine, two amino acids that are supportive of brain function and relaxation. Taken in conjunction, this “power trio” has been shown to have BRAIN-BOOSTING BENEFITS.  


In addition to being convenient (and just plain delicious), our Focus Gummies are formulated to be highly bioavailable. In essence, this means that an especially high percentage of their functional compounds make it into the bloodstream to have the most impact and effect. That’s one reason many people experience positive effects with just half a gummy a day. That said, because of the robust safety profiles of all ingredients, it’s perfectly safe to take up to two Focus Gummies a day for maximum support.

settings.title: FAQS
settings.text: Support clarity and focus the all-natural way. Learn more about our focus gummies, and the active ingredients we have carefully chosen to include in them. Stack cannabinoids CBD and CBG with adaptogenic fungi and other nutraceuticals for all-natural focus support.

settings.title: Does CBG help with focus?
settings.answer: CBG offers neuroprotective benefits that may help support brain function. In addition, RESEARCH SHOWS that CBG possesses antioxidant, anti-inflammatory activities, and has anti-anxiety, and appetite-stimulating effects.

settings.title: Does CBD increase attention span?
settings.answer: In part because CBD affects dopamine pathways in the brain, it’s believed to support mental clarity, focus, and attention. This is broadly SUPPORTED BY CLINICAL EVIDENCE that CBD helps reduce the severity and duration of many anxiety-related disorders.

settings.title: What mushroom blend is best for focus and energy?
settings.answer: When using mushrooms for focus, there are several factors to consider, including your personal physiology and metabolism. But centuries of traditional medicine wisdom (and modern clinical studies) suggest that Lion’s Mane is the best supplement for mushroom-based focus and energy support. The proprietary blend in our Focus Gummies stacks the benefits of Lion’s Mane with other botanically derived ingredients to provide holistic focus support.

settings.title: Which mushrooms help with brain fog?
settings.answer: While several mushrooms can support healthier brain function, we believe the best is Lion's Mane supplement for focus and clarity, which has a VARIETY OF BENEFITS and may also support general cognitive function, reduce stress, and even support your immune system.

settings.title: What is the best Focus Mushrrom Gummy dose?
settings.answer: Our FOCUS GUMMIES are formulated to be highly bioavailable and effective. Beginners may want to start with just a half-gummy. For additional support you can take up to two gummies per day. Consistent use is the best way to determine if this product works for you. If you haven’t noticed any effects after the first few days, we recommend that you use this product every day for 30 days to see how it affects you. Don’t stress — you’re covered by our risk-free SATISFACTION GUARANTEE.
